scope: Offline development-capture label reconciliation only; no forwarding-path, live reassembly, feature contract, benchmark, episode or customer adoption
tool: Official Wireshark TShark4.6.9 pinned executable; offline two-pass read, numeric-only, isolated configuration/plugins, only Ethernet/VLAN/IPv4/UDP/data dissection; explicit IP defragmentation and IP/UDP checksum preferences
group_proposal: TShark proposes exact constituent frame-number lists for each completed IPv4 datagram. A local validator independently reconstructs bytes from those original frames. A tool row is not label proof. Scalar tool fields must contain a single occurrence. Ambiguous aggregated scalar values are explicitly rejected, including identical repeated values; the constituent-frame list remains intentionally multi-valued.
standard_key: Original directional IPv4 source,destination,protocol,Identification. Include VLAN tag stack as an additional observation-context boundary; mixed stacks reject. This differs from the inspected legacy Zeekv2.6.1 key and is not a historical replication claim.
supported_domain: Classic microsecond PCAP/Ethernet as checked by base90a; IPv4 UDP fragments with20-byte IP headers, complete captured bytes, valid IP-header checksums, no DF/reserved flag, legal8-byte nonfinal payload alignment and total reassembled length<=65535. Other fragments remain explicit unsupported demand.
completeness: Exactly one offset-zero fragment, exactly one final MF=0 fragment, at least two distinct source frames; sorted half-open payload intervals cover[0,final_end) exactly without holes, duplicates or overlaps. Every group member has the same standard key and VLAN stack. No invented ports for noninitial fragments.
overlap: Reject every byte overlap, including identical duplicates, conflicting payload, multiple first/final fragments and conflicting header context. RFC815 supplies completeness logic; this stricter observational rule avoids choosing an implementation-specific overwrite policy.
ID_reuse: Allow separate proposed complete groups for one standard key only when their observed constituent time windows are strictly nonoverlapping and frame-order windows do not interleave. Equal boundary timestamps reject the key. Any unresolved fragment sharing that key, any member assigned twice, or any rejected group vetoes all groups of that key. No guessed timeout, clock tolerance or orphan-to-first assignment. Accepted sequential reuse describes this offline observation, not proof of in-flight uniqueness outside the trace. Every rejected proposal vetoes every standard key recoverable from its recognized members, including proposals without a materialized record and rejected mixed-key groups. No key is invented for unknown members.
checksum: Independently validate every original fragment IPv4 header with RFC1071. Validate exact UDP length and the complete reassembled UDP pseudoheader checksum. IPv4 UDP checksum0 is permitted-but-not-present and separately counted, not called verified; a nonzero checksum must validate. Require TShark UDP checksum status to agree (good or not-present), and exact reassembled payload bytes/length/ports. A checksum is an integrity check, not proof against all possible misassociation.
timestamps: Retain each original microsecond timestamp and raw frame ordinal, initial-fragment time, earliest/latest constituent time and completion frame. Use the completion-arrival timestamp for comparison with source Zeek connection times, supported by the inspected Sessions.cc path; no source interval padding or offset fit. Ties within one group preserve raw frame order; ties across reused groups reject the key.
lineage: Retain source frame ordinal, exact frame SHA256, IP-header SHA256, fragment payload SHA256, payload offset/length, captured/wire length and timestamp. Each validated datagram retains exact member ordinals, reassembled payload SHA256 and IP-total-length bytes. Never substitute datagram counters for original wire-fragment counters.
connection_reconciliation: Merge validated datagrams with the base90a complete nonfragment packets and apply the unchanged exact source tuple/time/orientation and whole-connection packet/IP-byte reconciliation. Unresolved fragment families remain vetoes. Original zero-counter rows and labels are unchanged; C&C/scan stay outside DDoS-versus-benign. Transfer labels to constituent wire frames only through a validated datagram in a fully reconciled original source connection.
timer_profile: Profile admitted source connection durations and actual inter-datagram gaps at1s/15s idle and10s/60s active; retain the prior diagnostic grid only as explicitly named datagram-domain cache mechanics. No model or deployment-delay result.
sampling_boundary: Ground-truth reconciliation may use the full development trace. In wire-before-meter conditions only selected original frame bytes may feed extraction/reassembly/features. Quantify complete versus partial member selection for denominators1/2/10 using the fixed base90a ordinal seed. Separately report after-reassembly datagram selection. Neither route is declared live policy and unsampled bytes/ports/counts may not become sampled-condition features.
forwarding_boundary: RFC1812 Section5.2.6 prohibits transit-router reassembly before forwarding. This offline labeling step does not impose forwarding or detector-copy reassembly. Any later software fragment cache, sampling position, CPU/memory/delay behavior and failure policy need their own lab test.
failure_accounting: Count all original fragment frames and all proposed groups: valid, rejected, unresolved/orphan, overlap, holes, truncation, unsupported protocol/options/context, bad/absent checksum, shared membership and reused-ID ambiguity. Preserve originals and all unresolved demand in coverage denominators; no outcome-driven removal or binary label coercion.
source_limits: Source version/config/checksum handling and exact release-member association remain unknown. One capture is one scenario; source UID, datagram and timeout fragments are not independent attack repetitions. No final-source contents are opened.
VLAN_depth_metadata: Converted Packet.vlans retains tag-stack depth only. This does not add tag IDs to connection keys, establish tenant/source-label context, or claim a multi-VLAN label mapping.
review_delta: Fail-closed proposal-key veto and explicit ambiguous-field quarantine; no feature, label definition, source-role, model or live forwarding adoption.
reference_diagnostics: Audit complete-packet checksums without guessing historical policy, compare reconstructed-row UDP payload counters, report member spans and wire gaps, retain all meter label/expiry/source-row histograms. These are full-reference diagnostics, not sampled features or independent episodes.
